description.value: La Casa Gelato is a Vancouver institution housed in an iconic pink building on Venables Street, holding the Guinness World Record for 'Most Commercially Available Flavours' with 238 gelato flavours available at any one time. Family-owned and operated for three generations, the shop also offers gelato cakes, Italian pastries, and handmade chocolates. A well-known destination in East Vancouver and a natural stop for cyclists exploring the area — though note they accept only Canadian cash, Canadian debit, or U.S. cash; no credit cards.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 31m. Total: 3 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms the business is open, provides matching address and phone number, and describes a counter-service gelato shop selling individual servings, cakes, pastries, and chocolates — all inherently takeout. OSM payment tags (credit_cards=no, cash=yes, debit=yes) are corroborated verbatim by the website's payment notice. No bike-specific amenities, washroom access, or water refill are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: Website footer copyright reads '1999 - 2018' but content references the 2019 Guinness World Record, suggesting the footer has not been updated — not a substantive concern.
No credit cards accepted (cash and debit only); worth flagging for cyclists without local debit or cash.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, well-established, publicly accessible business with a confirmed address and active website. A notable local landmark and a practical refreshment stop for touring cyclists.
